messages:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up: we're prepping a reactivation blast tied to the latest latency/cost benchmark. Goal = win back dormant trials + drive webinar signups. Short plan below.
Devon Murphy: Nice. What's the primary segmentation criteria for 'dormant'?
Lena Ortiz: Dormant = created trial 30-120 days ago, <2 API calls in last 14d. Primary cohort = 20k users. Canary = 2k (10%).
Priya Kapoor: Send sequence: Day0 announcement (benchmark highlights + webinar invite), Day3 social proof email (customer quote + micro-benchmark), Day7 CTA nudge (webinar reminder + 15% credit offer).
Noah Kim: Regional send windows: NA 11:00 PT, EU 11:00 CET, APAC 17:30 SGT. We should timezone-slice by local TZ.
Lena Ortiz: Copy tone: product-led but humble. Subject line options to test: A) "Rediscover faster, cheaper LLM inference — new benchmark" B) "We cut avg latency by 40% — see how" C) "You're invited: benchmark demo + live Q&A".
Priya Kapoor: Preheaders: "Benchmark results + demo (plus limited credit)" and "Live walkthrough + Q&A — reserve your spot". We'll A/B subject lines in canary (3-way split).
Devon Murphy: CTA destinations: webinar landing (primary), blog post with full benchmark (secondary), and trial re-ignite flow (offer redemption). Use distinct UTMs: utm_campaign=reactivate_bench&utm_medium=email&utm_content={variant}.
Noah Kim: Lead capture -> webhook: POST https://hooks.redwood.com/marketing/leads. Include tag "reactivate_bench" and source "email_reengage". Also add field "offer_code" when user redeems credit so growth can reconcile.
Priya Kapoor: Design ask: one long hero (1200px) + compact hero (600px) + GIF showing latency graph. Can DevOps host GIF at cdn.redwoodstatic.com/starlight/gifs/latency-rise.gif?
Lena Ortiz: Yes, Ops can host. Also request: sprinkle a 1-line benchmark stat in subject or preview when possible — e.g., "40% median p99 cut". Only include when internal QA approves numbers.
Devon Murphy: Metrics to evaluate: opens, clicks to webinar, webinar regs, trial reactivations, offer redemptions, unsubscribe rate. Decision rule for winner subject: require 95% CI or wait 12 hours and choose top performer.
growthbot: Campaign draft created: reactivate_bench_canary scheduled at 1759480000. Reminder set to #growth.
Noah Kim: Ops note: please add a routing rule so webinar signups flagged "reactivate_bench" hit SDR queue "revival-team" with priority=medium. Also add tag "bench_interested".
Priya Kapoor: Can we do a mini personalization test? Use first name + usage stat: "Lena, see how your inference cost could change" vs generic. Test in the canary (50/50).
Lena Ortiz: Yes — but keep personalization fallback when we don't have usage metrics. Dev will inject {first_name} or use "there".
Devon Murphy: Timeline: copy + variants by Wed EOD, design assets by Thu noon, webhook & routing by Fri, canary send Mon 11:00 PT. Full blast Wed 11:00 PT if winner clear.
Noah Kim: I'll open ticket GROW-9123 to wire webhooks + hosting. ETA Friday.
Lena Ortiz: OK — Priya, Devon, Noah: sync on a 15-min QA call Friday 10:30 PT to run through links, UTMs, and unsubscribe checks.
Priya Kapoor: Confirmed. I'll prepare test list and QA checklist.
Devon Murphy: I'll generate the canary cohort (reactivate_canary_2k) and export CSV to #growth-private for QA.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks team. We'll include a short post-send follow-up: snapshot of canary performance + recommended winner or suggested tweaks. Ping if any blockers. :sparkles:
